name: Mineral Elemental, Huge
body:
MINERAL ELEMENTAL, HUGE CR 7

This creature appears as a glistening, rough statue of ore, with little multicolored crystals embedded in its body and gems for eyes.

XP 3,200
N Huge outsider (earth, elemental, extraplanar)
Init –2; Senses darkvision 60 ft., mineral sense 30 ft.; Perception +13

DEFENSE

AC 20, touch 6, flat-footed 20 (–2 Dex, +14 natural, –2 size)
hp 95 (10d10+40)
Fort +11, Ref +1, Will +7; +2 vs. rays (crystalline form)
DR 5/—; Immune elemental traits
Weaknesses vulnerability to metal-affecting spells

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft., burrow 20 ft., earth glide
Melee 2 slams +18 (2d8+10)
Space 15 ft.; Reach 15 ft.
Special Attacks natural weapon versatility, sharp edges

STATISTICS

Str 30, Dex 6, Con 19, Int 6, Wis 11, Cha 11
Base Atk +10; CMB +22; CMD 30
Feats Greater Sunder, Improved Sunder, Power Attack, Shrapnel Strike, Sundering Strike
Skills Appraise +11, Diplomacy +11, Knowledge (dungeoneering) +7, Knowledge (planes) +7, Perception +13
Languages Terran

ECOLOGY

Environment any (Plane of Earth)
Organization solitary, pair, or gang (3–8)
Treasure standard

The Plane of Earth is not only home to rock and magma creatures, but also contains metals, gems, and beings made of these substances. In the Worldcenter setting, mineral elementals mostly serve Achthael the Giver, Lord of Crystallized Light.

Mineral elementals embody the metal and gem veins of the world- they are prosperity and wealth themselves, and for some races, beauty itself. Many of them appear as crude humanoid forms made of raw metals and crystals, but other shapes are known as well. When at rest, they resemble heaps of ores.

As peaceful and slow to anger as other earth elementals, mineral elementals are rare because dragons, dwarves and other greedy races search them to harvest precious materials from their bodies. It is said that the metal and gems from a mineral elemental’s body can be used to create perfect armaments and powerful magic items.

The few mineral elementals still in existence, however, are extremely powerful and dangerous if they have to fight for their own lives. Occasionally, even a valuable magic item may be found infixed or encased in a mineral elemental’s living body.
